scope: Independent complete file/log/decompressed-trace and normalized sensor checks, exact archived physical witnesses and current report parity.

New bearing, Ready-window coverage, request/source/completion/measurement/predicted-arrival epochs, current-state/opponent provenance, residual query charges, physical busy actors and actor throttle independently recomputed.
Retrospective rigid geometry independently recomputed only after continuous actor/material/ownership and age checks; no later geometry enters an earlier forecast.
Historical native choice and capture outcomes protected by exact whole-run trace/probe/evidence parity and preserved prior independent audit, rather than rerunning every older solar formula.
Four overlapping source intervals in one quiet world. Three samples per controlled source are correlated repeated measurements; 16 arms are not 16 independent worlds.
All observed physical samples are measured; negative/incomplete, dirty-query and low-budget cases have focused test coverage, not observations in this corpus.
Synchronous local sensing only; no policy-strength, match outcome improvement, live multiactor scheduler fairness, device timing or capture-value-admission claim.

audit_strengthening.description: After the frozen experiment began, the runner auditor was strengthened to require first request generation equals first eligible current tick. This independent audit checks that rule for every raw row, including stable identity through deferrals.

validation_counts.source: Parent-reported successful local runs; this audit did not rerun the test suites or independently inspect complete saved test logs.
